The event `finalized_checkpoint` from  ethereum/beacon-APIs https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/blob/3a86761a176fd3ffe540ea0a416a6220864ee6c8/apis/eventstream/index.yaml#L58

- (b) When THE HEAD state has its finalized checkpoint updated
- (c) When the forkchoice store `Store.finalized_checkpoint` is updated
